desc: A fox-like creature whose body is a hollow of black shadow wrapped in torn yellow wallpaper, tail of three bent fluorescent tubes, glowing green exit-sign eyes, sharp ear spikes, eerie and ornate. Not a normal animal: a Backrooms anomaly creature, still small and pet-like, chibi 2-head-tall, right-facing 3/4 view, full body centered, clean pixel art, flat 3-tone shading, single dark outline, no ground shadow, no particles.
